# Player

`player`

The account that connects to a server. It owns who the person is (friend code, settings, the admin flag, the character played last) and a list of characters (CharacterRoster); all progress in the world is the character's (PlayerCharacter).

> Separate who connects from who walks the world, so one person can keep several characters

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| friendCode | string | The code a friend types to join this player's world |
| settings | json | Client settings (sound, graphics, language, tutorial); kept on this player's machine |
| admin | boolean | Whether the host lets this player use admin commands |
| lastCharacter | string | Id of the character this player entered last, offered first in the list |
